title: Vineyard Poker Championships
seo_title: Vineyard Poker Championships in Ozark, MO | Dec 8
description: The Vineyard Poker Championships is an invite-only poker tournament where players who earned their seat through previous Vineyard poker nights compete for one championship, with fine cigars and friendly rivalry along the way. The buy-in is $50, and reservations can be made by calling (417) 882-0399 or online. It takes place Tuesday, December 8, 2026 at 6:00 PM at Vineyard Market, 1759 W State Hwy J, Ozark, MO.
